title: Defective Product
text: Defective Product. Amazon is really starting to bum me out. I’ve belonged for a long time but it’s so disheartening when you receive a defective product. The magnet part is great but it does not open up all the way and the stick for the paper towel. Only one side fits. The worst part is I have it shipped out of the country. It’s not worth the money to ship back. I’m renovating a house and it’s very expensive. I hate wasting money, especially now since I have to watch every penny. It’s a simple device and it wasn’t made right. Just sucks
